title: The Mold Room
text: A room of casting molds lies broken open, dozens of them, all empty but one. That one is still sealed, as big as a coffin, its clay cracked. Something was poured into it a very long time ago and never broken out. It is still warm.

options.label: The strongest breaks the sealed mold to see what has waited so long.

outcomes.text: Inside is a perfect blade, as warm as if it was poured an hour ago.
Inside is a golem, half-made and angry about it.

options.label: Leave it sealed; whatever is warm in there has waited for a reason.

outcomes.text: As you go, something inside knocks twice. You all hear it again in your sleep.
Behind you, the mold cracks open.

options.label: Haul it out to sell, still sealed, and let the buyer open it.

outcomes.text: It is heavy enough to bruise every shoulder that carries it, though it sells well.
